title: Validate receiving-plan quantity storage before procurement logistics commitment
description: Close explicit receiving-plan TotalQuantity storage integrity gap. ReceivingPlanLifecycleRules.ValidateProposedAsync copies proposed.TotalQuantity unchecked; EnsureQuantityPositive only rejects <=0 at submit/approve. Actual EF SQL scalar defaults to decimal(18,2), so positive overprecision silently rounds and huge positive values fail SQL; draft writes can consume a server plan number first. Add pure representability guard through existing receiving lifecycle at draft create/update and positive commitment under existing locks. Preserve explicitly documented draft support for zero AND signed negative quantity when representable; do not invent a positivity requirement for drafts. Operational submit/approve remains positive and must preserve exact stored quantity. Do not repurpose finance amount normalization to change logistical quantity or infer booking source from legacy BookingNo. Preserve all existing identities/menu/customer scope, live masters, source ownership, deterministic row locks and transaction contracts. No new permissions, schema/migration, currency conversion or implicit inventory/finance posting. Historical reads and undo actions retain existing rules; no new draft-validity gate on cancel/void/unaudit. Adapt required original fixtures with genuine live identities/masters and original assertions intact. Explicit logs/TRX/results under .ai/logs/<task> only, preserve full original failures. Verify actual EF/SQL column types in a fresh GUID-owned isolated NEWERP_AUTOTEST; never production access, drop/reset or existing database reuse. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Receiving-plan create/update validates TotalQuantity against actual SQL precision/range before plan numbering or tracked mutation, refusing overprecision/overflow with controlled error rather than truncation. Preserve representable zero/negative draft values and existing unit semantics, bounded texts, supplier/port/container-type validation.

Submit/approve revalidates exact positive stored quantity within existing plan locks and live authority/master gates. Existing legacy BookingNo remains text only; no inferred link or quantity posting. Invalid operations change no plan, number, status or downstream evidence; historical cancellation/read gates remain unchanged.

Meaningful unit/controller and genuine isolated SQL verify EF and SQL precision, positive/negative boundaries, exact decimals/overprecision, huge decimals, legal zero/negative drafts denied commitment, positive lifecycle and rejected zero writes/numbering. Run original receiving authorization/master/state/concurrency SQL regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: Container1.ContainerReceivingPlan.TotalQuantity is decimal with no explicit HasPrecision in ErpDbContext.Config (only plan-number unique index). ReceivingPlanLifecycleRules:220 copies quantity, :178-182 only positivity at operational boundary; class explicitly permits signed drafts. ERP-361/482 guard lifecycle/canonical server number but not storage representability. History/docs dedup found no receiving numeric-storage task.
